basics.name: Md Afridi Sk
basics.label: Backend Engineer
basics.headline:
I breathe tokens
for life.
basics.intro: Backend engineer in Bangalore. I take systems from architecture to production: agentic loops, real-time voice, peer-to-peer sync. I reach for whatever language the problem wants, usually TypeScript, Python, Rust, or Go. IIT Kharagpur, 2023.
basics.summary: Backend engineer specializing in the rapid delivery of AI-native systems. Owns architecture end-to-end across production agentic AI, real-time voice pipelines, and consensus-free distributed coordination, consistently shipping with strict telemetry, tests, and cost controls.

work.name: Ayoo Medical Pvt Ltd.
work.summary: Owning backend architecture for a healthtech platform — the agentic booking system, the abuse defence in front of it, the worker infrastructure behind it, and the AWS bill under it.
highlights: Built a patient-facing booking agent using a 17-tool calling loop matching doctors to complaints and handling payments, with typed error envelopes for in-loop model recovery.
Layered abuse defence ahead of inference via pre-model extraction screening, an IP-banning strike tool, OTP quotas, HMAC-SHA256 session binding, and a 20-key PII redaction pipeline.
Closed the loop on agent outcomes with a reaper that classifies expired conversations via a 4-field structured LLM call, with robust retry accounting and retroactive status correction.
Built an AI session summariser generating doctor notes and patient-specific summaries; audio is transcribed via Deepgram ASR and indexed in Pinecone (Gemini) for RAG.

Led extraction of the notification and worker service from the FastAPI monolith; a 4-queue Redis Queue system with per-channel selective retry (FCM, Exotel SMS, SMTP) decouples lifecycle events and reminders from the request cycle.
Cut slot-query latency to sub-50ms across 200+ endpoints with a MongoDB-backed doctor-availability cache using compound indexes and explicit invalidation.
Rightsized ECS-on-EC2 fleets (Auto Scaling, Aurora read replicas), cutting AWS spend 25% at a 99.9% uptime SLA.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Remote contract work, split between product delivery for SMB clients and evaluation work for AI labs.
highlights: Shipped 8+ production full-stack apps (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) for SMB clients; owned architecture, CI/CD, and deploy lifecycle.
Reviewed 200+ LLM code solutions for Scale AI (Outlier); authored RLHF QA rubrics driving a 12% lift on coding benchmarks.
Engineered adversarial Docker terminal benchmarks (AfterQuery) exposing multi-step reasoning gaps in SOTA models; built reproducible evaluation harnesses.

projects.name: Colloquium
projects.tagline: A Discord-style P2P desktop app with no backend at all: direct WebRTC calls, encrypted local history.
projects.description: A serverless Discord-style app for Windows and macOS: group spaces, voice and video, synced watch parties, clients dialling each other directly over WebRTC. History lives in a local SQLCipher-encrypted SQLite file. A consensus-free sync engine (hybrid logical clocks, gap-based state transfer) keeps peers convergent without a coordinator; watch parties run through a bundled ffmpeg sidecar that remuxes to HLS on the fly.
highlights: Consensus-free sync via hybrid logical clocks and gap-based state transfer
4K60 screen share over adaptive WebRTC Transport BWE
Echo cancelled at the OS layer, RNNoise suppression in an AudioWorklet
Watch parties via a bundled ffmpeg sidecar and loopback HTTP server

projects.name: MyTorBox
projects.tagline: A stateless Stremio addon that turns a TorBox library into browsable catalogues. 10k+ calls in week one.
projects.description: A Stremio addon that turns a TorBox library into browsable movie and series catalogues, enriched with TMDB metadata and rated posters. Stateless by design: API keys ride in the install URL, not a database. A four-tier parser matches 250k+ items to canonical TMDB entries.
highlights: 95% cache hit rate across 10k+ API calls in its first week
Credentials sealed with AES-256-GCM stream sealing
Cache stampedes eliminated via promise-chained locks
Chunked metadata envelopes bypass native Redis byte limits

projects.name: AgriSetu
projects.tagline: A voice-first agricultural marketplace where farmers place collective orders by speaking, in their own language.
projects.description: A voice-first marketplace that aggregates scattered farmer demand into collective orders. A real-time pipeline streams PCM over WebSocket to AWS Transcribe, through an LLM, and back as Polly TTS. A geospatial engine matches orders to vendors under Haversine constraints, with drift-free cross-unit price harmonisation and a bidding state machine. Flutter for farmers, Next.js for vendors, one Express and Prisma backend.
highlights: Real-time PCM over WebSocket to AWS Transcribe, back via Polly TTS
Geospatial demand aggregation under Haversine distance constraints
Drift-free cross-unit price harmonisation and a bidding state machine
Monorepo: Flutter mobile, Next.js web, Express + Prisma API

projects.name: Gofetch
projects.tagline: A Go download manager with segmented concurrent transfers, resumable state and a live terminal UI.
projects.description: A native Go download manager with curl-like commands: concurrent segmented range downloads, pause and resume from a task file, a terminal UI with per-thread progress and speed, same-host static-site mirroring, and mirror benchmarking ranked by latency and throughput.
highlights: Segmented Range downloads with configurable worker counts
Pause and resume from a task file kept out of the working directory
Same-host static mirroring for HTML, CSS, JS, images and fonts
Mirror benchmarking ranked by latency and throughput

projects.name: LeetCode Companywise
projects.tagline: Practise LeetCode filtered by company, frequency and difficulty, with progress charts that mean something.
projects.description: An interactive dashboard for practising LeetCode by company, frequency and difficulty. It tracks what you've solved and charts completion across both, so prep has a shape instead of a list.
highlights: Filter by company, frequency and difficulty
Solved-problem tracking with completion stats
Difficulty and company distribution charts
Dark mode

projects.name: opsbot
projects.tagline: A DevOps agent skill that turns a coding agent into a careful senior engineer for your fleet.
projects.description: An agent skill that connects to remote hosts over SSH or AWS SSM and runs tested procedures for diagnosis, deployment, nginx, hardening and provisioning. It inspects before it mutates, and asks before any change, especially on prod.
highlights: Resolves targets from a declarative host inventory
SSH via PEM key, or AWS SSM
Inspect before mutate, confirm before change on prod
Procedures for diagnosis, deploy, nginx, hardening, provisioning

projects.name: CVPilot
projects.tagline: Tailors a resume to a job posting: truthfully, inside a git worktree, straight to an ATS-ready PDF.
projects.description: A Claude Code skill that keeps a full career history in one structured file beside a LaTeX shell. For each posting it researches the role, selects only truthful relevant material, and renders a one-page ATS-optimised PDF with a repo-local tectonic binary. The whole run stays in an isolated git worktree, so tracked files never change.
highlights: One structured career database, with no invented claims or metrics
Researches the role and company before selecting material
Renders a one-page ATS-optimised PDF locally
Runs in an isolated git worktree

projects.name: AI Battle Arena
projects.tagline: Two LLMs fight in a real-time canvas arena. Plug in any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and watch them think.
projects.description: A real-time battleship-style arena where two AI models fight. Each takes its own base URL, model and API key, so any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, local or hosted, drops in. A 60fps canvas renderer runs the physics and combat while each model's intent and reasoning stream to on-screen logs, side by side.
highlights: Two independently configurable AI models fight live
Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, local or hosted
60fps canvas physics and combat rendering
Live intent and reasoning logs streamed per model

projects.name: GreenSpin Firefox
projects.tagline: A Firefox theme that brings back the classic grey-and-green tab loading spinner.
projects.description: A minimal userChrome.css theme that patches only the tab throbber, bringing back the grey connecting circle and green spinning loader from the Firefox 4-to-29 era. Nothing else in the UI moves, the spinner brightens in dark mode, and its install path is built for AI coding agents to run themselves.
highlights: Patches only the tab throbber, with zero other UI changes
Classic grey-then-green spinner from Firefox 4 to 29
Dark-mode-aware spinner brightening
Installable by an AI coding agent, not just by hand

projects.name: ccswitch
projects.tagline: A zero-dependency CLI for switching between Claude Code API configurations.
projects.description: A tiny, zero-dependency CLI that stores named Claude Code configurations (API key plus base URL) in a dotfile and writes the active one into Claude Code's settings. Add, test, list and switch from one command, on macOS, Linux or Windows.
highlights: Zero runtime dependencies
Live key and base-URL testing before you switch
Cross-platform: macOS, Linux, Windows

projects.name: Cloudpad
projects.tagline: An offline-first markdown notepad. IndexedDB, tabs, PDF export, no account.
projects.description: An offline-first markdown notepad that keeps every note in IndexedDB. Multiple tabs, pinned notes, search, live preview, PDF export and keyboard shortcuts, plus controls for theme, typography, sidebar position, density and width.
highlights: Notes stored locally in IndexedDB, so nothing leaves the browser
Tabs, pinned notes, search and live preview
Markdown to PDF export
Theme, typography, density and layout controls

projects.name: P2P FileShare
projects.tagline: Browser-to-browser file transfer over WebRTC. No server in the middle, no size cap.
projects.description: A peer-to-peer file sharing app on WebRTC and PeerJS. Each side gets a peer ID, the two connect directly, and the file streams browser to browser. Nothing touches a server, so there's no upload limit and nothing left to delete.
highlights: Direct browser-to-browser transfer, no server storage
Real-time transfer status
Works in any modern WebRTC browser

projects.name: Slack AI Chatbot
projects.tagline: OAuth 2.0 and Slack request verification written from scratch, then an LLM bolted on top.
projects.description: An OAuth 2.0 Slack chatbot that wires Slack events to LLM APIs with secure token management. The OAuth handshake and request-signature verification are written from scratch rather than pulled from an SDK, with Redis and MongoDB behind them.
highlights: OAuth 2.0 and request-signature verification from scratch
Modular service architecture
Redis and MongoDB for session and token state

projects.name: Portfolio Website
projects.tagline: This site. Astro, a markdown blog with Mermaid and Shiki, and a theme toggle that wipes.
projects.description: A minimalist portfolio with a markdown blog system: Shiki syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, tag filtering, Giscus comments, and a light/dark toggle built on the View Transitions API.
highlights: Markdown blog with Shiki highlighting and Mermaid diagrams
Tag filtering and search
Giscus comments
Light/dark theme on the View Transitions API

projects.name: doc-shadow-removal
projects.tagline: Paper implementation: background estimation to lift shadows off scanned documents.
projects.description: A MATLAB implementation of the paper "An Effective Background Estimation Method for Shadows Removal of Document Images," using neighbouring-pixel shadow mapping to estimate and subtract background illumination.
highlights: Background estimation for shadow detection and removal
Neighbouring-pixel shadow mapping
